turns.customer: Order #1039 hasn't even arrived yet but I already know I don't want those sandals. Can I send them back once they get here?
turns.reply:
Not yet. Your order is still marked as shipped and returns can only begin once it's delivered. Once it arrives, you'll be able to start the return using the return label in your account, and the warehouse will issue the refund when the item comes back.

If it does show up damaged, let me know and I can help with that instead.
